mapper.sql: SELECT 'OS' AS SOURCE_CD, ASSET_ID AS OBJECT_ID, TRIM(COALESCE(OS_NAME, '') || CASE WHEN OS_VERSION IS NULL OR OS_VERSION = '' THEN '' ELSE ' ' || OS_VERSION END) AS OBJECT_NAME, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, OS_EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE FROM TB_IF_SERVER_ASSET_PILOT WHERE OS_EOL_DATE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'MW' AS SOURCE_CD, MW_ID AS OBJECT_ID, PRODUCT_NAME AS OBJECT_NAME, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE FROM TB_IF_MW_INSTALL_PILOT WHERE EOL_DATE IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'DB' AS SOURCE_CD, DB_ID AS OBJECT_ID, DB_NAME AS OBJECT_NAME, ASSET_ID AS ASSET_ID, EOL_DATE AS EOL_DATE FROM TB_IF_DB_INSTANCE_PILOT WHERE EOL_DATE IS NOT NULL
